notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-08-14
notes.notes: Fixed a crash caused by viewing a detailed controller layout in a Scene 1 puzzle.

notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-07-14
notes.notes:
Quality of Life Improvements Puzzles can now be replayed from the Load Game menu after beating the game
 Diagonal folds are now easier to start with a controller
Bug Fixes Fixed Spanish localizations that were using the incorrect gender

notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-05-18
notes.notes:
Quality of Life Improvements Alternate solutions to puzzles should more reliably work
 Mouse controls are now more accurate and responsive
 Diagonal folds are now easier to start with a controller
 Climbing up and down blocks can now be completed much quicker
 There is now a significantly shorter delay after unfolding the paper before regaining control of the character, especially when unfolding them to the back of the paper
 Tutorials can now be closed
 Papers will now always rotate in the center of the screen regardless of their current size or shape
Bug Fixes
Cameras Puzzle cameras no longer remain active once the character leaves the puzzle
Characters Fixed an issue with the Teacher’s arm in climbing animations
 Characters no longer get stuck in infinite fall loops after unfolding
Localization Fixed strings in Brazilian Portguese and Arabic that were using an incorrect quotation symbol
 Fixed a text message in Arabic that was left-aligned
Papers Papers in Chapter 6 no longer clip through the camera when they rotate
 It is no longer possible to fold over characters
 It is no longer possible to solve a puzzle in such a way that the character cannot walk out of it
 Glowing edges will now only appear when input is allowed
Physics It is no longer possible to create a situation where the physics of a level do not align with the visuals
 It is no longer possible to trigger a star while falling out of a puzzle
 Significantly reduced the possibility of characters and blocks falling out of puzzles when they are flipped
Pushable Blocks Resolved a potential crash when a puzzle was unfolded with the character standing next to a pushable block
 Characters no longer teleport or get stuck inside blocks when rotating next to them
 Blocks can no longer be pushed off ledges
 Characters can now grab a block that has a one unit space above it
Roadblocks Roadblocks no longer have a chance to permanently lock the Teacher after swiping at them
 Roadblocks no longer swipe at the Teacher every time the paper is flipped or unfolded
Tutorials The reset puzzle tutorial is now only shown once per play session
User Interface Continue button no longer appears unless there is an active game in progress
